"Hints for floor markings"
This article is for travelers

Pet Lounge Floor Markings

Floor markings in the pet lounge help you move safely, keep carriers in the right place, and avoid crossing into staff-only space. At Aurelia Skyways, the Companion Animal Travel Desk uses these marks to guide boarding flow and reduce stress for animals and handlers.

Start by following the colored path from the check-in side to the waiting area. Keep pets close and do not stop on marked walkways unless a staff member asks you to pause. If you are traveling with Archie or another companion animal, stay with the route shown on the floor and avoid cutting across open corners. Clear floor space also helps crews guide carts, clean surfaces, and maintain a calm boarding area.

Some markings show where to stand while staff review papers or prepare equipment. Others show where crates, strollers, or carriers should be set down. If you see a line or box on the floor, use it only for its intended purpose. Staff record service changes in the desk ledger, and they will direct you if your animal needs a different path or a quieter waiting spot.

If your travel includes a stop at Vellmar, follow the lounge instructions closely. <<FACT F002>> Keep your pet settled, use the marked waiting zone, and wait for the next instruction before moving again. The lounge layout is built to keep circulation smooth, so please do not shift barriers or step beyond the visible guide marks.

For a connection that involves Merrowgate, pay attention to the quarantine area signs and floor indicators. <<FACT F029>> Use only the route marked for travelers and do not enter unmarked doors or side passages. If you are unsure where to stand, remain by the nearest floor symbol until a staff member arrives.

When in doubt, keep to the marked path, move at a steady pace, and follow the instructions from the desk or the floor crew. Calm stepwise review is used when service needs change, so there is no need to rush. For more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
